---
name: ✨ Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: feature
assignees: ''
---

## 💡 Problem

What problem does this solve? What can't you do today?

## 🎯 Proposed Solution

Describe the feature and how it should work. Include UI sketches, API shapes, or examples if helpful.

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why this one is better.

## ✅ Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Criterion 1
- [ ] Criterion 2
- [ ] Tests written and passing
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs/ as needed)

## 📎 Additional Context

Roadmap week / milestone, links, mockups, related issues.
